exposure: gasless single-port access (SPA) laparoscopy using a J-shaped retractor
cohort: The study included 80 patients who underwent laparoscopic adnexal surgery between May 2017 and April 2019.
finding: The study found no significant differences in patient characteristics, total operation times, operation type, conversion rate, use of additional trocars, pathological outcomes, or major complications between gasless and conventional SPA laparoscopy for adnexal surgery.
